title: 展望台用の固定双眼望遠鏡
description: 展望台や遊歩道の眺望ポイントに置く固定式双眼望遠鏡の静的モデル。実形状の二つの対物鏡筒・接眼部、上向きの本体、傾斜軸ヨーク、握り、基部固定金具、硬貨スロットと無地の点検パネルを備えます。レンズは不透明な単色表現で、拡大・光学・課金・可動機能はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.636 × 1.585 × 0.531 m、24,656三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static fixed binocular viewer for an observation terrace or scenic promenade. Includes two distinct objective barrels and eyepieces, an upward-tilted head, tilt-pivot yoke, grips, base anchors, coin slot and blank service panel. Lenses use an opaque constant-color representation; no magnification, optical, payment or articulation functionality is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.636 × 1.585 × 0.531 m; 24,656 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
